### Owner-visible observations (out of scope; report only, no edits)

1. **No run category has a pathway file.** This run's 128 frontier pages (64 pairs) sit in six categories: `quantum-field-theory` (22 pages), `quantum-field-theory-mathematics` (40), `relativistic-particle-mechanics` (20), `thermodynamics` (24), `thermodynamics-mathematics` (18), `einstein-maxwell-models-mathematics` (4). None has `library/<category>/_pathway.md`, so `pathway-sync` placed nothing by design ("does not invent a pathway for a category that has none") and the frontier `pathcheck` gate is vacuous here (0 pathway files checked). All 128 frontier pages are `draft` (verified directly from frontmatter), and `pathcheck`'s `pathway-missing` warning fires only for published pages, so the zero-warning result is expected now; at publication those categories would warn and would keep rendering dependency levels instead of a reading order unless reading orders are authored. Authoring a category reading order is a reading-order change and a new artifact; this dispatch authorizes only rewriting existing named part bodies, so I did not create pathway files.
2. **Remaining `categoriesWithoutPathway` entries** are this run's six categories (receipt counts, at A-page granularity: qft 11, qft-math 20, rpm 10, thermo 12, thermo-math 9, emm-math 2), eight physics categories from earlier runs (`classical-electromagnetism` 18, `classical-electromagnetism-mathematics` 10, `special-relativity` 12, `general-relativity` 15, `non-relativistic-classical-mechanics` 18, `non-relativistic-classical-mechanics-mathematics` 16, `non-relativistic-quantum-mechanics` 22, `non-relativistic-quantum-mechanics-mathematics` 8), and eleven read-only imported mathematics categories (`algebraic-geometry` 37, `algebraic-topology` 25, `braid-groups` 19, `commutative-algebra` 22, `computability-theory` 43, `differential-topology` 34, `fourier-analysis` 22, `homological-algebra` 31, `pde` 29, `probability` 23, `scheme-theory` 27), which are not physics-owned.
3. **Pre-existing imported-math defect (read-only copies; not introduced by this run; outside the frontier gate).** For context only, I ran an unscoped read-only `pathcheck` over the corpus: it reports 3 hard `part-page-foreign` errors — `library/abstract-algebra/_pathway.md` part `actions-and-presentations` lists `symmetric-groups-and-the-sign-homomorphism` and `conjugacy-and-simplicity-in-the-symmetric-groups`, and `library/combinatorics/_pathway.md` part `generating-functions` lists `permutation-statistics-inversions-and-eulerian-numbers`; each of those pages lives in `coxeter-groups`. Both physics copies are byte-identical to the root mathematics originals (`cmp` clean), so the defect is inherited rather than physics-authored, and the run's own frontier-scoped gate is green and touches none of these files. The same unscoped scan also shows 19 `pathway-missing` and 10 `overview-missing` warnings for published categories outside this run's frontier (including the earlier physics runs' categories, which have published pages but no pathway).

### Blockers

None for this dispatch. No mathematical brief was rewritten here, so there is no new mathematical claim from this stage to certify; the engine's stage gates (`pathway-closure check`, frontier `pathcheck`, frontier `prosecheck`, closure gate) all run against the unchanged, current artifacts.
